facts.fact: Only 33% of verified Google Business Profiles have messaging turned on, according to the Adwave article.
facts.quote: only 33% of verified Google Business Profiles** have messaging turned on

facts.fact: Google tracks how quickly a business replies to GBP messages, and slow replies can reduce local search visibility, per the article.
facts.quote: Google tracks how quickly you reply, and taking too long can ding your local search visibility.

facts.fact: When messaging is enabled, customers see a 'Chat' button next to a business's hours and phone number on its Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: they’ll see a prominent **"Chat" button** next to your hours and phone number.

facts.fact: The page states that by 2026, 80% or more response rates will be the standard for customer messaging expectations.
facts.quote: by 2026, **80%+ response rates will be the standard**

facts.fact: The page describes Google Business Profile messaging as a free tool.
facts.quote: this free tool is perfect for maximizing impact

facts.fact: Google tracks the response rate as the percentage of new GBP messages a business replies to within 24 hours.
facts.quote: Google tracks the percentage of new messages you reply to within **24 hours**.

facts.fact: According to the page, a low GBP messaging response rate can hurt a business's visibility in local search results.
facts.quote: A low rate here is a serious red flag. It signals a poor customer experience and can even hurt your visibility in local search results.

facts.fact: According to the page, scheduling messaging availability won't directly hurt a business's search rankings because Google understands most businesses have set operating hours.
facts.quote: The short answer is no, scheduling your availability won't directly hurt your search rankings.

facts.fact: According to the page, GBP messages can be managed from the Google Business Profile dashboard on desktop, not only through the Google Maps mobile app.
facts.quote: You can now manage all your customer chats right from your Google Business Profile dashboard on a desktop.
